decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer. Industry turnover grew and the large firm has the slack to carry it, so nothing signals a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for alternatives.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the filtration portfolio and the firm's sustainability positioning. No evidence of underperformance and ample slack in a growing industry favor keeping it.
This multi-model nozzle line is a low-cost accessory that builds on the established offer. It likely meets aspirations, and carrying it costs little.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's core business, where performance is likely satisfactory relative to past results and peers, so management has no reason to drop it.
The magnetic belt conveyor builds on established conveyor competence and serves metalworking customers. Satisfactory expected results and available slack support retention.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a staple of the firm's core range, so results likely meet aspirations and dropping it would weaken the full-line offer.
